system.description:
You weave threads of magic to seek out a sleeping creature, intrude upon its slumber, and tamper with its dreams.

Choose either a sleeping creature you can see within 10 spaces, or a creature you have met face to face that is currently asleep within 1 kilometer of you.

If the creature wishes to resist this effect, they may make an opposed Willpower check to negate the effect of the spell.

If the creature does not resist, you fall unconscious for 10 minutes while you enter the target’s mind, witnessing whatever dream the creature experiences.

Each extra success extends the duration by +10 minutes.

Though you can observe the dream undetected for the duration of the spell, you may also attempt to meddle with the dream.

  • You can change a number of the dream’s aspects equal to your Mind.

  • You can alter aspects such as who appears in it, the presence or placement of objects, the overall setting, what is said, and any other details as you see fit.

  • Should violence occur during the dream, neither you nor the target are physically hurt, though the experience may be stressful.

  • When the target awakens, it remembers the dream in startling detail. It may have new ideas, or it may change an otherwise decided- upon course of action.

  • Sufficiently disturbing dreams may even prevent the target from gaining the benefits of a Rest.
